alt: A motorcycle gang riding together in matching leather vests down a road in Ambrosia.
The Ambrosia skyline at night featuring smoke stacks in the distance.
A woman hugging a man from behind in Ambrosia, draping her arm in front of him displaying the handgun she's holding.
A field of crops burning at sunset in Ambrosia.
A man sitting behind the wheel in Ambrosia as multiple women in bikinis wash his car.
Three people covered in mud pose on an airboat in the Grassrivers with a dead alligator and wildcat. One has an automatic weapon leaning against his leg, another is holding a rifle.
A speed boat drives toward buildings on piers overlooking the water. In the distance is the Vice City skyline.
A topdown view of two people in an airboat surrounded by alligators in the Grassrivers. One holds a gun aiming at the alligator closest to him.
A helicopter and two police cars chase a pick-up truck through a swamp with alligators in the Grassrivers. An airboat is seen in the background.

A menacing-looking man sits next to a campfire holding a knife in one hand and a large dead snake over his shoulder. A beer bottle and dead gator are on the bench next to him, and several other figures can be seen in the background.

An alligator's eye glows red, reflecting off swamp water in the foreground as an airboat carrying three men approaches. One of them totes a longarm while a flashlight cuts through the mist. A crescent moon hangs above the mangrove trees.
Jason riding a motorbike close to the pavement, with a patrol car and multiple helicopters behind him in quick pursuit. Splashes from raindrops are visible on the surface of the road.
Jason grimaces while pointing a handgun at a large, armed, and tattooed figure in the foreground. A second biker-type looms in the background, holding a gun.

Jason, wearing a helmet while atop a motorbike, points a submachine gun offscreen while two other figures on bikes cover their backs inside a mall hallway. Two armed guards are pointing handguns at them in the background.
Jason, handgun tucked behind his back, squares up against three men: one making a fist, another holding a knife, and a third climbing out the back of a pickup.
A shirtless Jason bench-pressing weights.
Jason closes one eye while aiming a customized assault rifle, surrounded by sparks, and standing in front of a plane with its cargo ramp open and a dog wearing tactical goggles.
Jason leans out the passenger-side window of a car, automatic weapon in hand. Sparks careen off bullet holes in the car door; the back window is cracked; two blurry helicopters fly overhead.
A nighttime shot of Jason refueling a red car at a gas station while two cops approach him from behind, guns drawn. A helicopter flies with its searchlight on in the background.
Jason driving, a focused look on his face, with a male passenger in the seat next to him.
Jason and Lucia robbing a Fleeca bank branch, both wearing bandanas and duffel bags, armed with SMGs.
Jason and Lucia sitting on the hood of a pickup truck parked on a hill overlooking Vice City. A pack of birds are taking flight in the distance, and a family of deer are grazing in the tall grass.
Jason looms over the driver's side door of a car, pistol in hand. Lucia is in the background, wearing sunglasses and holding a bag over her shoulder.
A scene inside The Rusty Anchor bar: A group of Leonida locals raise their drinks in the foreground while Jason and Lucia dance on the crowded dance floor behind them.
A scene inside The Rusty Anchor bar: A group of Leonida locals raise their drinks in the foreground while Jason and Lucia dance on the crowded dance floor behind them.
Jason and Lucia sit in a convertible with the top down, neon reflecting off the windshield. Both are holding handguns.
A seaplane flying over water in the Leonida Keys. In the background a bridge with cars connects two islands.
An iguana walks in front of a mobility scooter in the Leonida Keys as people pass by in the background.

The exterior of a beach bar in the Leonida Keys with many people: a man sits at a picnic table passed out surrounded by empty bottles, a couple is kissing, people are walking into the entrance, and others are hanging out on the front porch.
Two scuba divers swimming underwater in the Leonida Keys surrounded by aquatic life including coral, fish, an eel, and a sea turtle.

A gathering of people partying and drinking on boats in the water in the Leonida Keys. A man lays on a flamingo floaty. People jet ski in the background. Others are seen laying out and tanning on boats.
A lionfish swims among seaplants with a diver shining a flashlight in the background; a boat idles on the surface.
Lucia holds a handgun in front of a rain-flecked window.
Lucia driving and pointing a handgun off-screen.
Close-up of Lucia pointing a handgun.
Close-up of Lucia holding a handgun to her chest with a cop, patrol car, and city lights in the background.
Four people riding dirt bikes through the mud in Mount Kalaga National Park. An ATV jumps behind them.
A news helicopter flying over a tree-filled ridge in Mount Kalaga National Park.
Two people holding rifles walking side by side through the woods of Mount Kalaga National Park.
A winding road goes between two steep hills with greenery at the top in Mount Kalaga National Park.
A cougar stalks a herd of deer drinking from a stream in Mount Kalaga National Park.
A person wearing a life vest kayaks toward a bridge in Mount Kalaga National Park.
The outside of a motel in Port Gellhorn with the vacancy sign lit up at night.
Two men from Port Gellhorn in a room with grow lights look in the same direction. One is resting his hands on top of a shovel and the other is holding a baseball bat resting on his shoulder.
A woman in Port Gellhorn leaning into the open window of a car handing a package to a man sitting in the back seat.

The outside parking lot of a club in Port Gellhorn at night with signs lit up advertising the cabaret. Several cars are parked, a few people linger outside of the club, and two people walk under the sign, one pushing a shopping cart.

People gathered at a bonfire in Port Gellhorn. One couple is off to the side with the man leaning back on the hood of a truck and the woman putting her finger to his mouth while reaching for his belt.
A dancer with a full back tattoo of a skull presses against a pole in front of a neon sign for Delights Cabaret.
Jason and Lucia standing back to back at sunset.
Jason and Lucia leaning against a green car in front of palm trees and a distant skyline.
Jason and Lucia standing outside the Ocean View Hotel holding handguns. The '55 Vapid Stanier sedan is behind them.
Jason and Lucia standing side by side, in front of the '55 Vapid Stanier at sunset.
Jason and Lucia dancing together inside a club.
A close up of Lucia's face.
Jason holding a submachine gun that is covered in a tropical weapon pattern.
Lucia holding a cocktail skewer with two olives at her lips in one hand, and a martini glass in the other.
A close up of Jason's face.
Jason and Lucia sitting inside a parked '55 Vapid Stanier at night.
Jason and Lucia sitting inside a parked '55 Vapid Stanier at night. Jason has his arm around Lucia and is holding a handgun.
Close up of the front fender of the '55 Vapid Stanier.
Close up of the taillights on the '55 Vapid Stanier.
A collection of weapons and a bag full of cash on the backseat of the '55 Vapid Stanier.
A jet flying over a sign that says Vice City.
A woman and a man standing close on a balcony overlooking a pool, trees, and the beach of Vice City.
A view of Vice City with roads, palm trees, a basketball court, and more buildings in the background.
A man in Vice City pulls back his lip showing off his grill while another man next to him points two fingers forward.

People near a lifeguard stand on the beach in Vice City. In the foreground a woman in a bikini lays down tanning while men walk by and look. In the background a couple holds hands, a woman jogs, a woman sits on her phone, and two men play catch with a football.

Two women being handcuffed by a police officer in Vice City. Another woman is in front of them taking a selfie, and another is posed on top of the police car as the other policeman points to the ground.
A club in Vice City with multiple dancers around a pole as dollar bills float in the air.
A Vice City skyline at night featuring a ferris wheel, cars driving, and tall buildings.
A road in Vice City where cars are driving and people on dirt bikes and ATVs are performing tricks.
A packed Vice City nightclub: disco balls, lights, plants hanging from the ceiling, and people packing the dance floor, many of them with their hands in the air.
A bearded man in a white suit offers a younger man with acne scars a handgun inside a car.
An exterior shot of a marina: boats, glittering water reflecting the sunlight against a backdrop of the Vice City skyline, a lone airliner in flight.

A close-up of a young man with face tattoos and multicolored locs holding a hand over his face. He's wearing a colorful camouflage bucket hat, a ring shaped like an angry dolphin, and a gold-tone watch.
A wide shot of police surrounding a yacht with boats, cars, and a helicopter.
Close-up of a tattooed dancer lying on top of dollar bills, wearing a Sessanta Nove bikini, fishnet top, and thigh-highs.
Close-up of a man with wicks wearing sunglasses and a gold S4S chain while holding a chain connected to a pitbull in a gold-spiked collar.

Group shot of a shirtless tattooed man holding a gold SMG and getting his hair braided inside an apartment. A man in embellished jeans checks his phone while a woman fills a backpack in the background.

A close-up on a heavily tattooed man sitting for a portrait, staring directly into the camera while a woman puts her manicured hands on his shoulders. Both have M7 tattoos. Two more tattooed men stand in the background.
A wide shot of a neon-lit gas station at dusk featuring a lowrider with underglow, a man siccing his dog on another man, and motorbikes riding by on the adjacent road.
A group shot of dancers applying lipstick, counting money, and posing in front of a green room vanity mirror topped with bright incandescent lights.
A group shot of a daytime car meet: A young woman in streetwear and sneakers poses on the hood of a heavily customized pink muscle car while other figures mill around tuned-up cars in the background.

A young man with wicks, face tattoos, a large chain, rings, and a watch strikes a mean expression while surrounded by women in a nightclub. A woman's behind, a smartphone's camera flash, and several hands throwing money are visible in the foreground.
A birds-eye view of a hotel pool and cabanas. Flamingos and gulls fly by.
A wide shot of Vice City at twilight: Traffic waits on both sides of a drawbridge as a speedboat skims toward the city's skyline.
